mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months lowers discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) signals weak labor demand, reducing investor confidence and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below the long-term average triggers a risk-on reaction, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals weak supply-side momentum, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above trend signals strong supply-side momentum, raising growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
